title: Automating Supply Chain Inventory Analytics
business: Operations managers at mid-sized logistics firms who need to monitor stock levels across regional warehouses.
problem: Manual data extraction from fragmented SQL databases leads to delayed inventory replenishment decisions and stockouts.
solution: SpotterCode acts as an AI pair programmer to bridge the gap between natural language requests and complex SQL execution, enabling real-time inventory visibility.
steps: Connect the logistics database to the ThoughtSpot environment.
Use SpotterCode to generate SQL queries based on natural language prompts regarding regional stock levels.
Validate the generated code against the schema to ensure accuracy.
Embed the resulting analytics visualization into the internal operations dashboard.
outcome: Operations teams gain immediate, self-service access to inventory data without requiring constant intervention from data engineers.
limitation: The generated code is dependent on the quality of the underlying metadata; users must verify results against known baseline inventory reports to ensure the AI has not misinterpreted schema relationships.
